text: Q6: Design completed-run extension for deep-research and deep-review. Today a completed packet halts (step_classify_session on_completed_session) and the completed-continue lineage mode is deferred, so the only way to add iterations is --restart, which archives the registry, strategy and questions. How should an in-place extension work (completed-continue or an --extend=N flag): which config fields change, which ledger event records it, how the reducer, convergence floor and synthesis treat pre- and post-extension iterations, and which files and tests change?
source: operator note 2026-11-17: if extension is not supported we should add it
